steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: <size=30>The Yagyu executive was right. There are indeed other ambushes.</size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's not gonna work, they're only dying for nothing. Hey, we gotta think about our next step. We can't really go down with her...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, attack coming on your right.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I saw it.
A survived Yagyu member is growling as he charges at Hecate, his body entirely driven by a hysterical fear. Right now!
You push Hecate away and fall into the thug's grasp in her stead.

steps.speaker: Tender steak paired with juicy cactus slices, followed by big gulps of icy mint tea... there's no greater comfort for Hella after a long day.
steps.content: Chief!
Stop.
You murmur. Hecate reads your lips and stops her hand from releasing the Nightmare. At that moment, that ever changeless face suddenly seems confused.
The next second, his knife is already on your neck.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: What happened?

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: Don't come near! Or I'll cut off his head!
steps.female_content: Don't come near! Or I'll cut off her head!

steps.speaker: Remnant Yagyu
steps.content: Haha, haha... You lied that you were their enemy... The Legion seems to care about you a lot... You're my hostage now!
He moves while dragging you, retreating toward the secret passage behind him step by step.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You ***, give him back!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****, Zoya! Why are you standing there? Go and save him. He's only taken because of you...
steps.female_content: ****, Zoya! Why are you standing there? Go and save her. She's only taken because of you...

steps.content: The accident makes the whole Legion freeze. Earl looks at you hesitantly, then at his commander. He doesn't make his next move.
But Zoya is only staring into your eyes—and laughs.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You're not gonna scream for help?
Her gaze is piercing. You struggle a little to show respect.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha, I'll...
Hecate is wordlessly pulling back Hella who's gone berserk, while Zoya is only standing still and watching the Yagyu member drag you into the narrow passage roughly. You can't hear her last sentence.
Yagyu chops open the contaminated weapon box. The spikes burst out and block the road. Then he dragged you into darkness brutally.
This is the first step. You got rid of the Legion.
